mia (marketing): Quick ask 8am PT announce on Tue								) - we need final changelog + docs links. Any API breaking changes?
kevin (eng): No breaking API changes. New quantized model variant + perf-mode flag. Drafting changelog now.
sophie (docs): I can sketch the release doc once I have the changelog and a sample curl/snippet. Aim EOD.
mia (marketing): Great. We need the docs link for the blog, email, and webinar slide. Webinar is planned Wed 11am PT, 30m. Grant to lead demo.
grant (product): Confirming webinar. Would like a 60s bench highlight for the blog: p50/p95 and cost delta.
kevin (eng): Bench snippet: rwd-4-small-quant, 128 tokens -> p50 ~42ms, p95 ~120ms, ~28% token cost reduction vs rwd-4-small. Will attach config.
olivia (growth): For inbound routing: route leads to sales@redwood, tag "bench-interest" in Drift, and create a lead template with fields: company, use-case, estimated volume.
sophie (docs): Placeholder docs URL: https://docs.redwood-inference.com/releases/1782001234-rwd4-quant (will replace). Adding Upgrade Notes: no forced changes, opt-in via model name.
kevin (eng): Changelog draft:
- Add rwd-4-small-quant (4-bit) with ~28% cost reduction
- KV cache improvements reducing repeat-prefix latency
- New `perf_mode` flag to tune batching behavior
Sample curl for docs:
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-4-small-quant","input":"Write a haiku","max_tokens":128}'
mia (marketing): Sophie, can you link the curl + changelog in the blog draft? Also need a short FAQ blurb on quantization tradeoffs.
sophie (docs): Will add FAQ and a short "When to use" table.
grant (product): Rollout plan request: canary Mon night -> full Tue 04:00 PT.
kevin (eng): Canary Mon 23:30 PT at 10% traffic. Monitor errors & latency; full ramp Tue 04:00 PT if healthy. I'll update release tags.
mia (marketing): Embargo until Tue 08:00 PT internal. Olivia will prepare the landing + webinar signup and share creative.
olivia (growth): Landing and Drift tag ready by Mon AM; will confirm once template is set.
deploy-bot: scheduled_deploy canary_start=1782060600, full_ramp=1782096000.
mia (marketing): Action items: Kevin finish changelog + bench config (TODAY EOD), Sophie publish docs draft (TODAY EOD), Olivia landing + lead routing ready (Mon morning), Grant to own webinar agenda. I'll assemble blog draft and submit for review Mon 09:00 PT. Please react with :thumbsup: when your piece is live.
kevin (eng): On it.
sophie (docs): On it.
grant (product): I'll share webinar outline and invite.
olivia (growth): Setting up Drift tag and lead template.
mia (marketing): Thanks team!
